rulings.ruling: Ruling: model error (arithmetic); IT-201-I (web edition), New York State tax rate schedule, "Married filing jointly and qualifying surviving spouse": for line 38 of $38,275, $1,202 plus 5.5% of the excess over $27,900, exactly $1,772.625; half-up to the dollar (amb.ny.2025.whole_dollars) $1,773.00, the project's. The model's work, "MFJ bracket 27,900–161,550: 1,202 + 5.5% × (38,275 − 27,900 = 10,375) = 1,202 + 570.625 = 1,786.13", has the product right (570.625) but writes the sum 1,202 + 570.625 as 1,786.13; the sum is 1,772.625. The Tax Table's example gives the same return the same tax: "Their taxable income on line 38 is $38,275 ... $1,773." Not a rounding difference and not a project defect. Recomputed from the source, not from the engine. Dropped from the fixture as not evidence.
